provenance_statement: This fixture is an internally generated MentorAmp development reference conforming to canonical Beginning-of-Month (BOM) withdrawal timing. Withdrawals are debited from opening account value prior to monthly interest crediting. It is NOT an independent LifeLib oracle run. It provides verified mathematical expectations for account-value rollforward, free withdrawal thresholding, surrender charges, and contractual MGSV accumulation.

tolerance.description: Internal arithmetic precision is 1e-12 for exact mathematical self-consistency; engine cross-check tolerance is 1e-6 for engine reconciliation.

anchor_case.description: Anchor benchmark: $100k single premium, 5-yr guarantee at 4.50%, $4,000 partial withdrawal at month 12.

excess_withdrawal_case.description: Excess partial withdrawal benchmark: $100k premium, 5-yr guarantee at 4.50%, $20,000 gross withdrawal at month 24 exceeding 10% free limit ($10,450 free limit, $9,550 chargeable withdrawal at 6% surrender charge).
